archetypes.name: producer-names
archetypes.rationale: Verifies every planned exclusion glob is anchored to real producer output names and phases rather than fictional or dead patterns.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the plan’s proposed transcript and sidecar glob patterns against the scripts that actually generate plan-review artifacts. Look for stale prefixes, omitted phased-output names, sidecar suffixes claimed without producer evidence, and accidental matches against assessor or vote artifacts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: artifact-policy
archetypes.rationale: Checks whether the top-level design-log policy, round-N policy, implement-log analogy, and docs stay consistent after the proposed change.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the plan preserves a coherent artifact-retention contract across design top-level logs, design round artifacts, and the analogous implement-log behavior. Focus on canonical-versus-raw artifact boundaries, documented exclusions, and whether the proposed denylist remains aligned with stated policy without silently changing unrelated artifacts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: fixture-realism
archetypes.rationale: Targets test-plan defects where fixtures may still assert fictional names or fail to pin the real regression surface.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the planned test edits for realistic fixture names, complete coverage of static and dynamic plan-review transcript variants, and assertions that would fail if raw reviewer outputs are still staged. Look for gaps between described fixtures and existing helper behavior, especially where suffix stripping or broad sidecar deny patterns could mask the intended regression. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
